public_history.clue: A common household pet that meows
Loyal animal that barks and fetches sticks
Large hoofed animal you ride with a saddle and reins
Feathered creature that flies and sings in trees
Scaly swimmer with fins and gills that lives in water
Small furry animal with long ears that hops around in a garden
Striped big cat that roars and hunts in jungles and forests
Legless reptile that hisses and sheds its skin
Big maned cat that lives in African grasslands and prides
Green amphibian that croaks and leaps near ponds
Howling wild predator that hunts in northern packs under the moon
Tiny rodent that squeaks and nibbles cheese in pantries
Large shaggy mammal that hibernates in caves and loves honey
Sly orange hunter with a bushy tail that raids henhouses at night
Farm animal that bleats and gives milk on a hillside
Black noisy perching flier that caws at dawn
Nocturnal hunter with big round eyes that hoots in the dark woods
Four-legged scaly reptile that basks on sunny rocks and darts through the grass
Antlered woodland grazer that bounds through meadows and forest clearings
Huge gray giant with tusks and a long trunk that roams savannas and jungles
Tiny social insect that marches in colonies and carries crumbs
Moo-ing farm mammal kept for dairy milk and beef
Pink snorting animal that oinks and wallows in mud on a sty
Frozen white flakes that fall from winter clouds
Crisp red or green fruit said to keep the doctor away
Burrowing mammal that digs tunnels under lawns
Slow shelled reptile that hides inside its armored home
Measured duration that ticks on a clock and passes steadily
Night flying insect attracted to porch lamps and flames
Animals: duck goose hen bee wasp bat eagle hawk swan gull shark whale seal otter zebra camel
